title: Кібератака групи UAC-0098 на державні органи України із застосуванням фреймворку Metasploit (CERT-UA#4560)

entities.name: UAC-0098
entities.gloss: A cyber threat actor associated with phishing campaigns and ties to the TrickBot cybercrime group.

entities.name: TrickBot
entities.gloss: A financially motivated cybercrime group known for developing and operating the TrickBot banking trojan and malware ecosystem.

entities.name: Meterpreter
entities.gloss: An advanced, dynamically extensible payload and post-exploitation tool widely used for remote command execution and control.

entities.name: Указ Президента України No 151 про безпрецедентні заходи безпеки.iso
entities.gloss: A malicious ISO disk image file distributed as an email attachment to drop malicious payloads.

entities.name: a.docx
entities.gloss: A decoy Microsoft Word document packaged inside a malicious ISO file.

entities.name: УКАЗ ПРЕЗИДЕНТА УКРАЇНИ №151_2022.mp4.lnk
entities.gloss: A malicious Windows shortcut file that triggers execution of a PowerShell script.

entities.name: z.ps1
entities.gloss: A malicious PowerShell script that opens a decoy document and executes a malware loader.

entities.name: b.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable payload that compromises the host with Meterpreter.

entities.name: loader.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable loader file associated with the attack infrastructure.

entities.name: admin@rs500cosworth.com
entities.gloss: An email address identified as an indicator of compromise in the campaign.
An IP address associated with command and control infrastructure in the incident.
